lines.text: Chat, we're going on a field trip. Ten feet. Very exciting.
Page twelve. A gate. With a lever. How hard can it be?
Wait. The pivot's drawn way over here. By the gate.
The farther you push from the pivot, the less push you need.
Old Archimedes said, give him a long enough lever and he'd move the world. I just want to move a gate.
Being scared's normal. Building something... helps.
Don't tell Tobias I said that.

rows.text: long arm + pivot near the load = easy lift
